cohort: Existing R1 hash-selected observed 64 markets; no expansion for primary inference
independent_initial_judgment: G2 is a useful infrastructure baseline, but unchanged symmetric passive entry and one-clip inventory ceiling do not establish Bosona decision-rule convergence. Inventory-sized taker reductions are real; their trigger and transferable edge remain unidentified. Compare mechanisms before recommending trading change.

mechanisms.name: inventory_scale
mechanisms.prediction: Taker reducing groups are larger pre-net relative to first observed parent acquisition and closer to complete flat than maker reductions; a universal fixed share or cost limit should separate reductions from additions/carry periods.
mechanisms.test: No optimized threshold. Report overlapping distributions and exact floor-to-two-decimals close quantities.

mechanisms.name: deteriorating_executable_or_reference_value
mechanisms.prediction: Before a taker reducing group, held bid declines over preceding 10/30 seconds, or latest observable Chainlink spot favors opposite side relative to published start reference, more often than maker reductions, additions/reversals and no-observed-reduction controls.
mechanisms.test: Fixed sign tests, public-second minus 5 and minus 10; missing features remain null. No probability fitting/threshold search.

mechanisms.name: time_unwind
mechanisms.prediction: Taker reductions concentrate after t240; earlier inventory is carried or reduced passively.
mechanisms.test: Fixed existing G new-risk cutoff t240; report early counterexamples and carry controls, no optimized age threshold.

controls: Original64 no-observed-first-reduction markets at t120/t240 where pre-cut exposure exists; fixed-time controls not claims about canceled/unfilled intentions. Parent-event comparisons are selected on filled actions, not opportunity-rate estimators.
economics: Use actual receipt cash for actor-conditioned delta only. Independent taker quote comparisons require fresh depth+fees, capped own inventory and terminal-only evaluation without subsequent actor fills. No guaranteed maker fills.
